instrument: BL2026-1391 / BL2026-1392, data center zoning regulations (July 21, 2026)
summary: Bans data centers over 500,000 sq ft, imposes buffers from homes, schools, hospitals and the zoo and along busy roads, requires a Board of Zoning Appeals special exception with a public hearing, and requires at least 15% renewable energy with incentives at 50%.
